data.summary: Dynamic and results-driven financial services professional with strong analytical skills and deep interest in capital markets, private markets, valuations, and corporate finance. Highly experienced in end-to-end trade lifecycle management across Fund Administration and Middle Office Operations, specializing in trade capture, enrichment, confirmations, reconciliations, SWIFT instructions, and break resolution. Skilled in NAV calculation, ETDs, OTC Derivatives, CCPs (CCS, TRS, CDS), and proficient in process optimization, controls, and automation.

responsibilities: Applied business day conventions and day-count methodologies for accurate cash flow projections.
Prepared MIS reports, KPIs, and defect logs to monitor trade processing performance.
Confirmed complex instruments (Reverse Repos, Bonds, Equities, CDs, CPs, Swaps) using CTM, Finastra, Fund Connect, and internal booking platforms.
Experienced in NAV calculation and Fund Accounting, ensuring accurate valuation of portfolios by reconciling trades, cash flows, corporate actions, and market prices
Managed trade capture, enrichment, and confirmations for Ultra High-Net-Worth clients and Buy-Side firms, ensuring seamless T+0 pre-matching and settlement.
Acted as primary escalation point for Front Office desks, resolving trade breaks, mismatches, and urgent discrepancies to minimize settlement failures.
Executed bulk uploads, pre-upload validations, and STP break investigations (security setup gaps, SSI errors), improving STP efficiency.
Designed exception-based controls, reconciliation workflows (TLM, Duco), and automated checklists to reduce manual errors.
Work on trade flow - Trade enrichment, Trade capture, Trade confirmation, and executing SWIFT instructions.
Served as SME for process migrations and transitions, ensuring SLA compliance and operational continuity.
Coordinated time-critical settlements with traders, brokers, custodians, and fund accounting teams.
Maintained static data accuracy, SSI validation, and counterparty setup for clean downstream STP.
Prioritized trades based on value, currency sensitivity, and market risk, reducing fail exposure.
Oversaw end-to-end trade lifecycle processing across Bonds, CDs, CPs, Equities, FX, Derivatives, and Money Market instruments.
Executed SWIFT messages (MT541, MT543, MT599) and processed high-value payments within strict cut- offs.

standardization_metadata.duration_policy: Year precision: annual-resolution estimates from year-label differences, including current reference year for current roles; months are estimated years times 12, not known elapsed months. Year-label unions use common annual boundaries only for computation; no employment month is inferred. Month precision: elapsed calendar months (approximate). Day precision: completed calendar units. Aggregate unions use first-of-month boundaries for month-only dates; residual days use 365.2425/12 days per month, rounded to one decimal year.
